query:
SELECT s.name, s.weight, s.category, CAST(i.value AS CHAR) as val, p.year, p.month 
FROM ims_data i 
JOIN skus s ON s.id = i.skuId 
JOIN periods p ON p.id = i.periodId 
WHERE p.year = 2026 AND p.month = 4 AND s.country IN ('Syria', 'Libya')
ORDER BY CAST(i.value AS DECIMAL) DESC
